content_sections.heading: IRCTC Consultant for Control Office Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant for Control Office: 10th pass from recognized Board. Preferably Graduate in any stream from any recognized University. Retired from Level-6,7,8,9 or 10 (7th CPC) from Operating/Commercial Departments of Indian Railways with minimum 20 years experience.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 64 years. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.irctc.com. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IRCTC Consultant for Control Office recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IRCTC Consultant for Control Office recruitment is 17th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed 10th from a recognized Board and preferably be a Graduate. Additionally, they must be retired Railway Officials from Level 6-10 (7th CPC) of the Operating/Commercial Departments with at least 20 years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant for Control Office post is 64 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant for Control Office position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Consultant for Control Office in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IRCTC Consultant for Control Office recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Consultant for Control Office post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultant for Control Office post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Consultant for Control Office position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Which department of Indian Railways is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for the Operating/Commercial Departments of Indian Railways.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of IRCTC, which is www.irctc.com.
